desk.headline: Revenue up 11% to $218.4m and adjusted EPS of $0.10, both above estimates; FY26 outlook raised after restatement
results: Revenue rose 11% to $218.4m, above the $202.1m estimate; adjusted EPS of $0.10 beat the $0.08 estimate, and GAAP net income rose to $16.4m from $1.1m.
Pharma Direct (+93%, helped by GLP-1 access programmes) and subscriptions (+41%) now make up more than half of revenue.
Core prescription transactions revenue fell 20% as monthly active consumers dropped to 4.9m from 5.4m.
Free cash flow was $81.1m; cash was $371.8m against debt of $491.3m.
First- and second-quarter results were restated after Pharma Direct revenue was understated; a review found former finance managers overrode controls.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 guidance raised to revenue of $844–850m and adjusted EBITDA of $280–286m. About $30m of the revenue increase reflects the restated first half; management expects a softer fourth quarter.

points: The CFO said about $29.8m of revenue and $21.4m of adjusted EBITDA in the new range come from the restated first half.
Fourth-quarter revenue and adjusted EBITDA are expected to be below the third quarter as prescription transactions and Pharma Direct ease.
Pharma Direct is expected to fall back in 2027 on lower GLP-1 unit economics, though stay well above 2025; no 2027 guidance was given.
CEO Wendy Barnes said condition-specific subscriptions have far exceeded expectations; most Employer Direct clients go live in January 2027.
Management signalled that total revenue may not grow in 2027, with adjusted EBITDA margins near the historical low-30% range.
